Rust crates statically linked into OpenKneeboard-OpenXR-Rust64.dll and
OpenKneeboard-OpenXR-Rust32.dll (`cargo tree -p okb-xr-layer -e normal`,
excluding proc-macro crates and their dependencies, which are not linked).
Each crate is dual-licensed; OpenKneeboard uses it under the MIT license.
